LanguageData.Gun_M240B_RWP.description: The M240B is a powerful, belt-fed machine gun designed for sustained fire. With a high rate of fire and significant stopping power, it excels at suppressing threats and providing covering fire. Its reliability and effectiveness at a range make it a formidable choice for defensive positions and open-field combat. However, it's heavy and cumbersome, requiring careful positioning and support to maximize its efficiency on the battlefield.
